artworks.title: Hubert Goltzius
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man's side profile view of his upper body and head. The man is facing to the right, showing his right side. He has pronounced facial features including a prominent nose and a thick, curled mustache. His hair is curly with a dense texture. He is wearing a high-collared garment with a visible ruffle around the collar. The garment appears to have a structured design typical of historic clothing. The background features fine line work for a textured effect, and there is a decorative border surrounding the oval frame of the portrait, with text inscribed around the edge.

artworks.title: Burning of the Old Amsterdam Town Hall
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a fire in an urban environment, with buildings, billowing smoke, flames, and people in a chaotic scene.

artworks.title: Two Men Penitent in the Wilderness
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a black and white etching of a woodsy scene featuring an individual walking along a path surrounded by large trees. Branches reach towards the sky, with rocky formations and smaller trees visible in the background. The horizon is obscured by foliage and rocky hills, suggesting a vast natural setting. The lines and textures are intricate, using cross-hatching and varied line densities to create depth in the landscape. The color scheme is monochromatic, emphasizing light and dark contrasts for visual richness. Plant life and textures are scattered throughout the ground.

artworks.title: Landscape near Vourlis
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white chalk on brown paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Jak Katalan in honor of Karen B. Cohen
artworks.description: The image displays a wide landscape view with flat terrain extending into the distance. The horizon is set about one third from the top, separating the land from a layer of clouds. The style uses delicate pencil strokes to depict elements such as grass, shrubs, and trees. The color palette is muted, dominated by earthy browns and grays, blending softly for an atmospheric impact. The sky has light cloud formations, enhancing the peaceful and naturalistic quality of the scene.

artworks.title: Rudolph II
artworks.artist: Aegidius Sadeler II after Hans von Aachen
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays an intricate illustration featuring a central oval portrait of a man. He faces slightly to his right, with a direct gaze towards the viewer. The man has a neatly trimmed beard, mustache, and curly hair with a laurel wreath. He is dressed in ornate armor with intricate detailing and a ruffed collar. Surrounding the portrait are decorative elements like structures of classical architecture, figures of Roman mythology, and symbolic creatures such as an eagle and Capricorn. Flanking the central portrait are statuesque figures in flowing robes on pedestals, one holding a torch and the other a long staff. The background is filled with ornamental designs like angels and a frieze with Latin text in a classical theme.

artworks.title: A Wooded Valley with Rocky Cliffs
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with watercolor on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a tree in the foreground, a horizon with mountains and a valley in the distance, and smaller trees and figures below. The painting depicts natural textures and features a color palette of earth tones, with a serene sky above.

artworks.title: Dancing Nude
artworks.medium: color monotype on heavy wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a figure in an impressionistic style with dynamic brushstrokes. The person is depicted in a twisting pose with one leg raised, head tilted left, and arms bent with hands behind the head. The figure's facial features are abstract, with flowing dark hair. They appear nude, with skin tones in browns, reds, and yellows. The background is a mix of colors like greens, blues, and browns. The scene emphasizes movement and dynamism without specific objects or scenery. No jewelry or objects are present.

artworks.title: Death and the Artist (Tod und Künstler)
artworks.medium: softground etching and drypoint on green wove paper (proof)
artworks.description: The image depicts a drawing of a person's head and upper torso facing the viewer. The person has a bald head with some hair visible around the sides and back, a prominent nose, and deeply shadowed eyes looking forward. Their hands are visible in the foreground holding a pen or pencil. In the upper left corner, there is a figure resembling a skeletal face in the background. The person is wearing a garment, and the background is a plain, textured surface with no distinct features, emphasizing the interaction between the two figures in the foreground.

artworks.title: Fjord
artworks.medium: woodcut in black on Japan paper
artworks.description: The image shows a series of structured terraces zigzagging upwards towards angular mountain peaks in the background. The terraces rise sharply, adding depth and perspective. The style appears to be a woodcut technique with bold lines and dark shading. The color palette is monochromatic, using black and the natural beige of the paper. Light and shadow enhance the angular and stepped composition.

artworks.title: Revolution
artworks.medium: woodcut in black on wove buff paper
artworks.description: The image displays thick, black, curving lines and angular forms against a light brown background. The word "REVOLUTION" is visible in a vertical orientation.

artworks.title: Saint Mark the Evangelist
artworks.artist: Peter Candid after Heinrich Aldegrever after Georg Pencz
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and wash, heightened with white over black chalk on laid paper, laid down
artworks.description: The image depicts a man seated on clouds, reading a book. He holds a pen in one hand. He has sharp features, a hat, and is wearing robes and a cloak. A lion's head emerges from the clouds to his left, holding a stone tablet. The background consists of stylized clouds and a glowing halo surrounds the man's head.

artworks.title: Ruins with Monkeys and an Owl
artworks.medium: complete set of 6 etchings on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays three monkeys in a classical ruin setting. One monkey is seated on a broken structure, another is on a pedestal, and a third sits on a stone urn. The composition emphasizes the ruins and the monkeys' presence. The sky features swirling clouds created through engravings, adding texture. The color palette is monochromatic, predominantly grey and black. The overall scene suggests a classical and whimsical atmosphere through architectural elements and animal interaction.

artworks.title: Forest Edge on a Brilliant Day
artworks.medium: brush with brown and gray wash on laid paper, mounted on album sheet
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Arturo and Corinne Cuéllar
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with tall trees dominating the scene. The viewpoint is from ground level, looking out into a grove of trees with the sky above. The horizon is low, hidden by the dense trees, rendered in darker tones and varied browns. The brushstrokes are soft and fluid, creating texture in the foliage. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia tones. In the distance, the sky has soft clouds, adding depth above the tree line.

artworks.title: Saint Augustine's Zealous Love of God
artworks.medium: pen and gray ink with gray wash and white heightening, incised for transfer on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Kurt Meissner
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene featuring angelic figures and symbols. The image shows a figure in a robe kneeling with hands clasped, surrounded by cherubic figures. Above them are swirling clouds, decorative elements, and a radiant triangle emitting light. The drawing is created in a style reminiscent of baroque religious art.

artworks.title: The Angelic Guards
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on heavy laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of individuals in a classical, sculptural style. The central figure is a muscular man sitting with a strong posture, holding a long spear or staff. He has a helmet with a plume on his head and sharp facial features. He is wearing minimal clothing, a draped cloth around his waist. Next to him is another figure reclining in a relaxed position, also wearing a helmet. In the background, a group of individuals are dressed in various headgear and clothing typical of classical and Renaissance styles. The background features clouds and an open sky, contributing to a dramatic atmosphere.

artworks.title: A Fashionable Couple Seen from Behind
artworks.medium: black and white chalk on yellow paper
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil sketch of a man and a woman standing side by side, viewed from behind. The man is on the left, with a slight bend in his right arm. He wears a top hat, knee-length coat, trousers, and knee-high boots. The woman stands on the right, leaning slightly forward, holding a closed parasol. She wears a wide-brimmed hat with a ribbon, a long dress with a fitted bodice and full skirt, and flat shoes. The background is plain.

artworks.title: An Alpine Village in Summertime
artworks.medium: black chalk and graphite heightened with white chalk on tan paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with mountains in the background, trees, buildings, and a bridge in the middle ground, and a gently sloping terrain in the foreground. The drawing is done in pencil with shading and white highlights to show texture and depth. The color scheme consists of soft gray tones and the tan color of the paper.

artworks.title: Young Woman with a Pearl Necklace
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Lowell Lisbon and Spink-Leger in honor of Diane Nixon
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman from the shoulders up. She is facing forwards with her head slightly turned to the left. The woman has a softly drawn face with features including arched eyebrows, almond-shaped eyes, a straight nose, and full lips. Her curly hair frames her face, styled naturally. She wears a simple necklace with round beads. The woman's clothing has a low neckline, but details are minimal. The background is depicted with hatch lines.

artworks.title: Adam and Eve at the Foot of the Cross
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts two nude figures in a complex scene. The male figure, on the left, is muscular with a full beard and curly hair, lying on the ground with his head tilted back. The female figure, on the right, sits with one arm raised behind her head, long flowing hair, and delicate features. Both have modesty leaves and vines covering some areas. In the background, there is a stone tablet with Latin inscriptions partly obscured by clouds, a reaching skeleton, stylized clouds, and chains on the ground around the male figure.

artworks.title: In der Wüste (In the Desert)
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on cream wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Alexander M. and Judith W. Laughlin
artworks.description: The painting depicts a ground-level view of a desert landscape. The horizon is placed two-thirds up the image, showing distant mountains and a clear blue sky with scattered white clouds. In the foreground is a sun-bleached carcass of a large animal, possibly a camel, with prominent visible bones. The brushstrokes are detailed, capturing the sand texture and the structure of the animal. The color palette includes muted earth tones, pale blue sky, and stark white bones, emphasizing the image's dryness and isolation.

artworks.title: Oriental Landscape
artworks.medium: charcoal counterproof on brown laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon is placed high in the composition, with small structures and a mountain silhouette in the distance. Two figures are near the base of a large tree. The trees and clouds are depicted with soft, blended brushstrokes, and the color palette is mainly warm sepia tones. The landscape fades into the distance with subtle detailing enhancing depth within the image.

artworks.title: Une Révolte a Bord
artworks.medium: lithograph on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene on a boat. The drawing depicts a small boat named "Le Barbillon" on a body of water. Three individuals are in the boat, with two seemingly engaged in a struggle or altercation, as one figure appears to be holding another by the shirt collar. In the background, another figure casually strolls along the shoreline, carrying something in its hand. The composition features various elements such as the gentle ripples of the water and an overcast sky, with a flock of birds visible in the distance. The artwork uses shading and line work to create texture and depth, conveying movement and emotion within the scene.

artworks.title: Paysage de sapins sous la neige
artworks.medium: salted paper print
artworks.description: The image shows a winter scene with a snow-covered forest. Coniferous trees heavily covered in snow dominate the left side of the composition. The horizon is not visible, as the snow-covered landscape merges with the sky. In the distance, leafless branches of deciduous trees stand tall. The scene has a soft, atmospheric quality with intricate details of the snow-covered branches. The monochrome palette emphasizes the contrast between the trees and the snow, highlighting the serene winter landscape.

artworks.title: Duc d'Alençon
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Robert Hershkowitz
artworks.description: The image shows a young boy standing upright, with one hand resting on a wooden chair. His posture is formal, and he is facing the camera with a slightly tilted head. The boy has short, curly hair and his facial expression is neutral. He is dressed in a dark three-piece suit with a white shirt and a tie. The background consists of a simple draped curtain, and the floor is covered with a patterned rug. The environment portrayed is typical of a traditional photographic studio setup.
